business_summary: Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited engages in the mining and sale of coal in the People's Republic of China, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Coal Mining; Smart Logistics; Coal Chemical, Electricity and Heat Supply; and Equipment Manufacturing segments. The company offers thermal, PCI, and coking coal; methanol, acetic acid, ethyl acetate, caprolactam, urea, ethylene glycol, naphtha, liquid paraffin, and crude liquid wax; coal mining and excavating equipment, cables, wires, cable accessories, and raw materials products; and chemicals, as well as involved in wholesale of petroleum and mineral products; and manufacturing of synthetic materials. It also engages in potash mineral exploration; electricity and heat supply; coal mining technology development, transfer, and consultation; finance leasing; leasing, trading, and commercial factoring; engineering; investment and asset management; educational software development; event planning; construction and production solar and wind power; providing railway, river, and lakes transportation; commercial; and logistics and transportation services. In addition, the company is involved in coal resource exploration development; port infrastructure construction; production and sales of mining equipment, electromechanical equipment, and rubber products; installation of mining equipment; coal and electrolytic copper trading; recycling of renewable resources; management of mineral resources, coal mining, and washing; operation of power generation; bonded area trade and warehousing; manufacturing of chemical products; and manufacturing of other metal processing machinery. The company was formerly known as Yanzhou Coal Mining Company Limited and changed its name to Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited in December 2021. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Zoucheng, the People's Republic of China. Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Shan Dong Energy Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited는 중국, 호주 및 국제적으로 석탄 채굴 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 석탄 채굴을 통해 운영됩니다. 스마트물류; 석탄 화학, 전기 및 열 공급; 및 장비 제조 부문. 이 회사는 열, PCI 및 원료탄을 제공합니다. 메탄올, 아세트산, 에틸아세테이트, 카프로락탐, 요소, 에틸렌글리콜, 나프타, 유동 파라핀, 조액상 왁스; 석탄 채굴 및 굴착 장비, 케이블, 전선, 케이블 액세서리 및 원자재 제품; 석유 및 광물 제품의 도매뿐만 아니라 화학 물질도 포함됩니다. 합성재료 제조. 또한 칼륨 광물 탐사에도 참여합니다. 전기 및 열 공급; 석탄 채굴 기술 개발, 이전 및 상담; 금융리스; 임대, 거래 및 상업적 팩토링; 공학; 투자 및 자산 관리; 교육용 소프트웨어 개발; 이벤트 기획; 건설 및 생산 태양광 및 풍력 발전; 철도, 강, 호수 교통 제공; 광고; 물류 및 운송 서비스. 또한 회사는 석탄 자원 탐사 개발에 참여하고 있습니다.
